g.text: PF-K. All three primary stations: selected regression window (low model error) around 26 September 2022
Selected example, chosen retrospectively for illustration; not representative of all dates. Chosen because GALE-CAST Model-W1's wind error was smaller than both baselines
Timing: each target date shows its own next-day (+1 day) forecast, issued after the previous day's observations (inputs = the 32 preceding days). The three dates are three separate
forecasts, NOT a +1/+2/+3-day forecast from one origin.
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (pooled scaled_weather inputs); X1 = mean of the three stations' scores on the date; warning if X1
≥ 0.601. GALE-CAST Model-W1 values are neural-only outputs (no MOS, no blending).
Baselines: persistence = observation of the issue day; climatology = station × calendar-month mean of raw observations, 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14. Event persistence = study label of the issue
day. Study label: wind ≥ 10.8 m/s OR same-station 24-hour MSLP fall ≥ 3 hPa.
Stations: NAIA, Sangley Point, Science Garden. n = 9 station-days. Common-window rule: spec/CASE_SELECTION_v2_regression.md. Observations: PAGASA; panel review export. Run
